description:
Data Analyst, New College Graduate (NCG)

 Location: San Jose, California
 Employment type: Full-time
 Organization: Business Intelligence

  

 About Astera Labs 

 Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) is a pioneering fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Silicon Valley, driving the evolution of AI and cloud infrastructure through purpose-built connectivity solutions. As a leader in rack-scale architecture, Astera Labs is enabling the shift to AI Infrastructure 2.0, where compute is optimized at the rack level to support next-generation workloads. Our portfolio spans high-performance silicon, software, and system-level solutions that address critical bottlenecks in data movement across compute, memory, and networking domains. We are committed to open standards, continuous innovation, and building a collaborative environment to solve complex challenges at scale.

   

 Role Overview 

 Astera Labs is seeking a Data Analytics Engineer NCG to support reporting, automation, and data pipeline initiatives across the business. This role will help turn business data into actionable insights, scalable datasets, and automated workflows that improve decision-making and operational efficiency.

 The ideal candidate brings a strong analytical mindset, curiosity about business systems and data flows, and hands-on experience or coursework in tools such as Excel, Power BI, SQL, and Azure-based data platforms. This person should be comfortable working across both analytics and engineering tasks, partnering with business stakeholders and technical team members to build practical, high-impact solutions.

   

 A Workday at Astera Labs 

 In this role, you will work primarily with the Business Intelligence team to support reporting, analysis, and automation initiatives in a structured learning environment. Your day may include working with sample or curated datasets, building Excel-based models or trackers, developing Power BI dashboards, writing SQL queries, and assisting with data pipeline and workflow automation tasks. You may also support recurring reporting processes, help document business rules and reporting logic, investigate data quality patterns in non-production datasets, and contribute to lightweight Azure-based integrations and process improvements.

 This is a hands-on internship where you will gain exposure to both business intelligence and data engineering work. You will learn how data moves across systems, how dashboards and reports are built for business users, and how automation can improve speed, accuracy, and scalability across core processes.

   

 Key Responsibilities 

 
 Assist in the development and maintenance of Power BI dashboards and reports to support business and operational insights

 Support data preparation activities, including data cleaning, transformation, and validation using Power Query and SQL

 Help connect and integrate data from multiple sources, such as databases, spreadsheets, and business systems, into Power BI

 Create and maintain basic DAX measures and calculations under guidance from senior analysts

 Assist with data modeling tasks, including building and validating relationships and tables used for reporting

 Write SQL queries in Azure SQL Database to support reporting, data validation, and business analysis

 Help create and maintain automated workflows in Power Automate for notifications, approvals, and recurring business processes

 Support lightweight integrations and automation using Azure Functions where applicable

 Perform data quality checks and help identify data inconsistencies or anomalies

 Support documentation of report definitions, data sources, data models, business logic, and workflow steps

 Learn and follow BI best practices related to data governance, security, and reporting standards

 
   

 Qualifications 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a related field

 Familiarity with Power BI, Power Query , and DAX 

 Experience using Excel for data analysis, such as PivotTables, formulas, charts, lookups, and basic dashboards

 Power Automate skills, such as flows, connectors, approvals, scheduled and event-based triggers, conditions, loops, integrations, and error handling

 Azure SQL Database skills, such as writing queries, working with tables and views, joins, aggregations, stored procedures, triggers, and query optimization

 Azure Data Factory skills, such as linked services, datasets, copy activities, pipeline development, triggers, parameterization, monitoring, and error handling

 Azure Functions skills, such as Function Apps, triggers, bindings, service integrations, logging, troubleshooting, and serverless design

 Familiarity with databases, data warehouses, or ETL concepts from classes, projects, or internships

 Comfortable working with structured and imperfect data, with the ability to identify inconsistencies, improve data quality, learn new tools quickly, and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment

 Interest in building scalable, reliable data solutions that support better business decisions

 
   

 Why Join Us? 

 
 Gain hands-on experience across analytics, BI, automation, and cloud data tooling at a company at the forefront of AI infrastructure

 Work on meaningful projects that directly improve reporting, process efficiency, and decision-making

 Partner closely with stakeholders across business and technical functions

 Build practical experience with modern Microsoft and Azure data platforms in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

 Competitive compensation and the opportunity to learn from experienced cross-functional teams

 
 Compensation

 The salary range for this role is $100,000–$110,000. This role may be eligible for a discretionary bonus.

 We know that creativity and innovation happen more often when teams include diverse ideas, backgrounds, and experiences, and we actively encourage everyone with relevant experience to apply, including people of color, LGBTQ+ and non-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities.
